annotations.title: Invoice factoring cost and effective APR

description: Find what factoring one invoice costs and its effective APR from the advance rate, discount fee, days outstanding and flat fees. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

advanceRate.description: Advance rate. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. The share of the invoice the factor pays you up front.

days.description: Days until the customer pays (days). From the funding date to the date the factor collects the invoice.

fee.description: Factoring discount fee per period. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. The fee rate in your agreement for each fee period.

feeBase.description: Fee is charged on. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for fee is charged on. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: face = The invoice face value; advance = The amount advanced.

flatFees.description: Flat fees per invoice (US dollars). Wire, ACH, processing, credit check or other per-invoice fees.

invoice.description: Invoice face value (US dollars). The amount your customer owes on the invoice.

period.description: Fee period. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for fee period. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: 30 = Per 30 days; 10 = Per 10 days.

rounding.description: How partial periods are charged. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for how partial periods are charged. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: block = Each started period is charged in full; daily = Prorated by day.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_invoice_factoring_cost_and_effective_apr

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.

title: Invoice factoring cost and effective APR
